fix(ios): compare path prop by value, not pointer identity (#1037)

updateProps compared _path against the new prop with ==, i.e.
pointer identity. RCTNSStringFromStringNilIfEmpty allocates a new
NSString each call, so two updates carrying the same path string
never compare equal and "path" is marked changed on every props
diff, even when it didn't actually change. Downstream this
triggers an unnecessary document reload each time.

Compare by isEqualToString: after the pointer fast-path.

Also fixes a latent bug in didSetProps: the percent-decoding step
overwrote _path in place, so if that block ran twice with the same
raw _path (e.g. on the reload triggered by the bug above), the
second call fed an already-decoded path back into
CFURLCreateStringByReplacingPercentEscapes. Decoding into a local
variable avoids mutating the
